name: Seoul Guarantee Insurance Company
summary: Seoul Guarantee Insurance Company, together with its subsidiaries, engages in non-life insurance and other related operations to individuals and businesses in South Korea and internationally. The company provides surety insurance, credit insurance, reinsurance and related asset management, etc.; contract, non-contract, and financial and counter guarantee bonds; and commercial credit insurance, such as mobile phone contracts and credit sales. It also engages in collection of receivables; and insurance management and brokerage. Seoul Guarantee Insurance Company was incorporated in 1969 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.
